name: llm_cache
description: Manage the Dynamic Response Cache for external LLMs. Inspect cache hit rates, view token and USD savings, prune expired entries, or clear the cache.

action.description: Action to perform: 'stats' (view hit rate, savings, and disk usage), 'inspect' (view recent cached responses), 'prune' (evict expired entries), or 'clear' (empty entire cache).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to display when action is 'inspect'. Default is 10.
